14.text: Walmart reported Q3 sub-30-minute delivery volume surged, is launching AI agent profiles with spending limits, and is weighing advertising's role in agentic shopping. It also faces grocery price pressures, a new Sam's Club bundle competing with Costco, and TikTok Shop's challenge.

11.text: Costco announced a $30-per-share special dividend and reported 12.6% October U.S. comparable sales growth, while articles recommended Realty Income and compared PepsiCo, Starbucks, Chipotle, Kraft Heinz, e.l.f. Beauty, On, Kimberly-Clark, and McDonald's as 2027 picks. Walmart is not mentioned.

10.text: Walmart rolled back prices on nearly 8,000 items and is using tariff refunds to offset over $2 billion in added fuel costs, while Kroger, Target, and Amazon offered Thanksgiving meal deals. Target booked $301 million in tariff refunds, and the FTC is investigating DoorDash and others over pricing data use.

5.text: Walmart reported Q3 FY27 revenue of $188.8B (up 5.2%) and adjusted EPS of $0.65, both beating consensus, while U.S. comparable sales missed; it raised its full-year outlook. Analysts debated its rich valuation, with Truist raising its target and citing strong e-commerce despite cooler profitability.

20.text: Walmart reported 5.2% third-quarter revenue growth to $188.8 billion, with U.S. e-commerce up 23% and advertising up 37%, and raised full-year guidance for the third time. Grocery share gains and 7,700 price rollbacks drove results, though the stock fell.
